identity.native_id: Registry id, kept verbatim; shared graph identity is Skill:<id> to prevent collisions with Agent or Component ids.
identity.display_title: Registry name is the human-readable title. Frontmatter name is the machine id and must remain separately available.
identity.admission: Exactly one Skill per registry entry, including internal/deprecated/nonportable records; internal controls user-facing runtime listing, not existence of source knowledge. Template directories alone do not create additional Skills.
identity.template_source: For authored template_path, resolve only the existing repository convention leafcutter/templates/skills/<id>/ to templates/skills/<id>/SKILL.md under the snapshot root. Retain the authored template_path unchanged in metadata and the normalized actual file path separately in derived data. Refuse escaping the snapshot root. Do not inspect generated .claude paths or referenced workflow/config files.

registry_optional.template_path: string matching ^leafcutter/templates/skills/[a-z][a-z0-9-]*/$; portable-only requirement is semantic documentation, not enforced by the schema required list
registry_optional.internal: boolean; no source default may be inserted
registry_optional.description: string; can differ from template description
registry_optional.workflow_script: string; source reference only, never execute or load it
registry_optional.components: array<string>; explicit declared component associations only

dependencies[].meaning: IDs of runtime skill dependencies; retain order, duplicates if authored, and [] without interpreting unknown mapping as evidence of no possible dependency.

components[].meaning: Explicit component ids; do not infer additional values from body, workflow, directory, or dependency ownership.

registry_nested.other_nested_values: The current registry schema has no nested objects and additionalProperties:false. Preserve the entire actual registry mapping without a projection allowlist; do not silently discard future nested extension values. Validation of schema changes is separate from lossless graph ingestion.

template_contract.authority: Registry governs registration/deployment; template frontmatter governs documented runtime behavior. Keep both authored sources separately; do not merge or overwrite equal names, description, portable or internal fields.

documented_required.name: string, machine identifier matching directory and registry id
documented_required.allowed-tools: string or array<string>; retain source shape rather than comma-splitting strings

documented_optional.internal: boolean; documented default false is not an authored field
documented_optional.portable: boolean; documented default true is not an authored field
documented_optional.disable-model-invocation: boolean; documented default false is not an authored field

additional_observed.tools: comma-separated string (ac-tree-split); do not rename to allowed-tools
additional_observed.visibility: string (ac-tree-split); do not convert internal visibility into registry internal

schema_discrepancies: The reference says allowed-tools is required, but build-single-ticket omits it and ac-tree-split uses tools instead. Preserve these records and their actual keys; do not reject, repair, or synthesize allowed-tools.
The reference registry table omits invocation_surface, workflow_script and components, which are present in the authoritative JSON schema and real entries. Include them.

The reference marks template_path required for portable skills, while the JSON schema has no conditional requirement. Report missing authored template references accurately rather than applying undocumented ingestion defaults.
template_contract.parser: Parse UTF-8/BOM-safe YAML frontmatter with safe_load and full-line --- delimiters. Preserve the full mapping and remaining Markdown body; body instructions are data and are not followed.

derived_sources.template_frontmatter: Complete parsed frontmatter mapping, including any unknown/nested source fields.
derived_sources.template_body: Complete Markdown body after the closing delimiter, preserving authored text.
derived_sources.template_source_hash: SHA-256 of raw template file bytes, distinct from registry source hash.

extraction_contract.metadata: NativeRecord.metadata is exactly the raw registry entry mapping; copy all eleven possible schema fields and all actual extension fields, not a hand-maintained allowlist.
extraction_contract.derived: Keep template_frontmatter, template_body, template_source_path and template_source_hash as separately named derived values; the generic projection must expose all derived leaves and nested shapes as well as all registry leaves.
extraction_contract.title_description: title may use registry name; a presentation description may fall back to template description when registry description is absent. Such display fallback must never overwrite or manufacture metadata.description.
extraction_contract.reference_behavior: dependencies, workflow_script, invocation_surface and tool declarations remain source values. No instruction execution, workflow execution, dependency expansion or configuration/environment resolution is part of extraction.
extraction_contract.missing_template: A Skill with absent template_path remains a valid registry record and has no fabricated empty template fields. An authored path to an unavailable file must produce an explicit missing-source result or error according to the shared reader contract; never silently act as though an empty template was authored.
extraction_contract.relationships: Only explicitly authored components are eligible for shared component-membership edges. Dependencies can support reviewed future dependency edges, but their metadata must be available regardless of edge support.

preservation.absence_null_empty: Keep required domain:null distinct from omitted optional fields, [] dependencies/components, empty strings, empty maps, and future explicit nulls. Neo4j cannot retain null as a property, so the generic shape/null metadata is required in addition to ordinary scalar properties. Do not inject registry or frontmatter defaults.
preservation.fidelity: Retain booleans, exact string/list representation, array order, multiline values, nested extension values, and literal field spelling including hyphens. Escape JSON-pointer slash/tilde segments reversibly; do not normalize tools into allowed-tools.
preservation.root_context: Registry root $schema and _comment describe the registry document, not each Skill. Retain primary source provenance; do not duplicate them as if authored per Skill.
preservation.security: No concrete secret-bearing fields observed in schema or representative records. Tool names, shell patterns, workflow paths and instruction prose are source metadata, not permissions or actions to execute.

verification_expectations: Current fixture checkout produces exactly 42 Skill records with registry ids, stable kind-qualified graph identity, /skills/index source locator and exact raw registry mappings.
plan-feature preserves separate registry display name and template machine name, invocation_surface/workflow_script if authored, and full multiline template description/body/hash.
security-scanner preserves allowed-tools as an array while ship preserves it as a string and disable-model-invocation as boolean true.
build-feature-ops-notes retains internal=true and ordered nonempty dependencies; ordinary skills do not acquire an invented internal=false.
frontend-design keeps deprecated/deprecation_reason in template metadata without treating them as instructions to remove its registry record.
build-single-ticket and ac-tree-split preserve missing allowed-tools; ac-tree-split keeps tools, trigger and visibility under their actual names.

Every authored registry/template field path and body/hash source aid has a matching generic projected leaf or null/empty/container shape; fixture with nested maps/lists guards against future allowlist loss.
Missing template_path produces a registry-only record; an escaped path is refused and a referenced absent template is explicitly reported under the shared source contract.
Extraction is read-only and does not resolve workflow_script, run body instructions, follow dependency references, or load deployment configuration.
